title: Uncrafting_Recipes
description: A mod that adds new recipes to uncraft certain items
body:
Uncraftable Items: \
any anvil: 3 - damaged state Iron blocks \
leather Armor: 1-4 Leather \
any wood type trapdoor, door, fence, fencegate, stair, slab ...: 1 plank of that wood type \
ladder: 3 sticks \
lever: 1 stick \
beacon: nether star \
furnace: 6 cobblestone
